description_en: Change the availability check method of an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于修改RDS实例的可用性检测方式
kebab_example: aliyun rds modify-ha-diagnose-config --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyHADiagnoseConfig

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The availability check method of the instance. Valid values:

SHORT: Alibaba Cloud uses short-lived connections to check the availability of the instance.
LONG: Alibaba Cloud uses persistent connections to check the availability of the instance
parameters.help_zh:
实例的可用性检测方式。取值：
SHORT：短连接
LONG：长连接
parameters.name: tcp_connection_type

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.name: region_id
